summary: Blog RTE + Emergent Object Storage image upload feature — full backend + frontend validation passed. 5/5 pytest tests green, full E2E flow (login → create post → cover upload → inline image upload → resize → save → publish → public reader) verified.
critical_code_review_comments: ImageCropUpload aspect selectors only render after a file is picked (correct behaviour, but the review_request implied they'd be visible immediately on modal open — testers should pick file first before asserting aspect buttons).

In RichTextEditor.jsx: `editor.getHTML()` is compared to `value` on every parent value change; deep updates during heavy typing could cause selection loss — currently mitigated by emitUpdate:false, no issue observed.
storage_service.put_object does synchronous requests.put inside async FastAPI handler — for high concurrency, consider httpx.AsyncClient. Not urgent for current SuperAdmin-only usage.
seed_data_creation: Created blog post 'RTE Test Post AUTO' (slug rte-test-post-auto) with 2 uploaded PNGs in Emergent Object Storage. Safe to delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end. Backend upload endpoint returns {success, data:{url,path}}; url is /api/public/blog-image/flowra/blog/<uuid>.<ext>. Public reader (BlogPage.jsx) rewrites this to absolute URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL prefix. When testing aspect selectors in ImageCropUpload, upload/pick the file first — aspects hide until preview is set.
